title: Kissed by Yeast Peruvian Potatoes Pilaf
description: A dense and sour Peruvian dish made with fast action yeast, perfect for a quick fix on a busy weeknight. This low-glycemic-friendly pilaf is a great option for those looking for a healthier meal option.
instructions: Add rice to a cataplana pot over medium heat and toast for 1 minute.
Add water to the cataplana pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, add yeast, anise seeds, salt, and black pepper, and cover the pot with a lid.
Let the mixture cook for 10 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Add diced potatoes to the cataplana pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in butter and cheddar cheese until melted and well combined.
Sprinkle cilantro on top of the pilaf and serve hot.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it sit for 5 minutes before serving.
